svg.title: W3NCY? contribution farm — day edition
svg.desc: A retro farm-style illustration of the actual 34 GitHub contributions across four active days, as of October 13, 2026. Each contributed day has a cow on its correct calendar square. In a scripted animation, a UFO arrives and briefly lifts a cow; then the farmhouse door opens, its owner checks outside, and the UFO leaves. Other squares are farmland. Static snapshot, not the built-in GitHub contribution graph.
